mechanism: SEEP: guided-gap firing loads a shallow Ag-ion side pocket beside the orthogonal program barrier; the ionic electrostatic field temporarily lowers that barrier and then decays by return diffusion.

decision.old_5000x_requirement: rejected as unnecessary as a hard material spec
decision.new_electrical_requirement: ~14x is the mathematical fresh/stale minimum for the selected HZO C and pulse; target >=500x fresh gain for variation margin.
decision.selected_model_result: fresh p0.1 gain exceeds 1000x at 100 ns while untouched and 500-ns stale branches remain below 0.15 V in >=99.99% of the modeled population.
decision.physical_blocker: fabricate one guided-gap + SEEP + orthogonal barrier coupon and measure ion capture, barrier shift, relaxation, endurance and temperature dependence.
